intro: Innkeeper Grosk manages the inn at Razor Hill, providing weary travelers with food, drink, and a place to rest in central Durotar. Located on the bustling road between the Valley of Trials and Orgrimmar, his establishment serves as the primary resting point for young Horde adventurers setting out into the wider world.

p: Razor Hill serves as the vital crossroad settlement connecting the southern training grounds of Durotar to the high walls of Orgrimmar. At the center of this waystation stands Innkeeper Grosk, an orc tasked with sheltering warriors, scouts, and peons alike. His inn offers a respite from the harsh desert heat, stocked with basic provisions, hearty meats, and cool water for any traveler passing beneath its sturdy timbers.

Beyond serving passing travelers, Grosk assists the local labor force that keeps Durotar running. In the quest 'A Peon's Burden', the timid peon Ukor, who hauled food all the way to the Valley of Trials only to find it was not needed, asks travelers to carry the load back to Grosk's inn in Razor Hill.
